{{Quote|By the moons of Gozgo, you are ''hopelessly'' gullible!|Cikatro Vizago, to [[Ezra Bridger]]|<ref name="Broken Horn">{{Rebels|Brothers of the Broken Horn}}</ref>}}
The '''moons of Gozgo''' were a group of at least two [[moon]]s located in [[the galaxy]]. The moons were referenced in a curse used by [[Cikatro Vizago]],<ref name="Broken Horn" /> [[Kemlin]]<ref name="THR2">[[The High Republic (2023) 2|''The High Republic'' (2023) 2]]</ref> and [[Orka]].<ref name="Dangerous Business">{{Resistance|Dangerous Business}}</ref>
